title: Frequently Asked Questions
intro: Find quick answers about SAGAR2027, submissions, registration, and the venue.

items.question: What is SAGAR2027 about?
items.answer: SAGAR2027 is an international conference on soft computing applications in smart grids and renewable energy. It will take place in hybrid (online and offline) mode on February 26-27, 2027.

items.question: How do I submit a paper?
items.answer: Submit your manuscript through Microsoft CMT as a PDF, following the provided publisher template and submission guidelines.

items.question: What are the submission deadline and conference dates?
items.answer: The paper submission deadline is December 30, 2026. The conference is scheduled for February 26-27, 2027.

items.question: Who needs to register, and what are the fees?
items.answer: At least one author must register for each accepted paper. Full registration is 10,000 INR for Indian authors and 200 USD for foreign authors; participation fees are 2,000 INR and 50 USD respectively. The registration link will be updated soon.

items.question: Where will the conference be held?
items.answer: The in-person event will be held at Ajay Binay Institute of Technology in Odisha. The venue is accessible from Biju Patnaik International Airport in Bhubaneswar and Cuttack railway station.

items.question: What topics are within the conference scope?
items.answer: The conference welcomes research on soft computing techniques for renewable energy systems and smart grids, including power systems, AI and machine learning, optimization, intelligent control, and emerging technologies.

items.question: What format and length should my paper follow?
items.answer: Submit a PDF manuscript with at least six pages of main content, prepared using the provided publisher template.

items.question: How are papers reviewed and considered for publication?
items.answer: Submissions undergo peer review based on quality, originality, technical contribution, and relevance. Presented and accepted papers will be considered for the Bentham Science Book Series, subject to publisher requirements.

items.question: What should virtual presenters prepare?
items.answer: Virtual presenters are required to submit a 10-12 minute pre-recorded presentation video in MP4 format. The video should be 720p or 1080p and no larger than 500 MB.

items.question: Can I attend or present online?
items.answer: Yes. SAGAR2027 is planned in hybrid mode. Virtual presenters should prepare a pre-recorded presentation video according to the conference guidelines.
